name: rennf93/guard-agent-php
description: PHP telemetry agent for the guard-core ecosystem: buffers security events, metrics, and agent status locally and ships them to the Guard Core App ingestion API with at-least-once semantics

suggest.ext-redis: Native phpredis client for crash-recovery persistence (optional; a dependency-free stream client is built in)
suggest.predis/predis: Pure-PHP Redis client for crash-recovery persistence (optional; a dependency-free stream client is built in)

scripts.lint: for f in $(find src bin -name '*.php'); do php -l "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo LINT_OK
